description: TorchVision ROI Align differential contract for finite feature maps and finite ROI coordinates.

bf16.note: TorchVision CPU has no BF16 ROI Align kernel; compare MLX BF16 with a TorchVision FP32 oracle fed BF16-quantized inputs and coordinates.

fp16.note: Compare native MLX and TorchVision CPU FP16 outputs after FP32 host export.

fp32.note: Pathological fuzz budget, including extreme coordinates; ordinary deterministic cases retain the stricter arrays.roi_align_output budget.
